gaps.sentence: His ___ (REFUSE) to cooperate stalled the negotiations.
The committee reached its verdict after lengthy ___ (DELIBERATE).
gaps.explanation: 'After lengthy deliberation' — the noun for careful discussion.

gaps.sentence: It is ___ (DENY) that the policy has failed.
gaps.explanation: 'It is undeniable that …' — adjective meaning cannot be denied.

gaps.sentence: The trainers were ___ (COMFORT) for long walks.
gaps.explanation: 'Were comfortable' — adjective; note the spelling: -able, not -ible.

gaps.sentence: The company needs to ___ (MODERN) its factories.
He's an ___ (ENTHUSIASM) supporter of the team.
Her sudden ___ (DIE) shocked the whole village.
gaps.explanation: 'Her sudden death' — 'die' is the verb, 'death' the noun.

gaps.sentence: He lost his ___ (CONFIDENT) after the failure.
